subject: how to analyze non-normally distributed data using scan1() for CC

messages.author: d3c445ee99455fe8
messages.subject: how to analyze non-normally distributed data using scan1() for CC
parts:
Hi all, 
    I am trying to analyze the CC data. The phenotypes were non-normally distributed. When i was performing the genome scan using the function scan1(), i wondered that if Haley-Knott regression suitable for my data. Or the r/qtl2 group have some advice for my data? Many thanks!
             Chenhan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] how to analyze non-normally distributed data using scan1() for CC
parts:
In what way is it not normal? And are you working with CC strain averages?

Haley-Knott regression might be fine. You might also consider transforming the phenotype, such as log or square-root.

karl
